TVK MLA V S Babu, who defeated MK Stalin, dies at 75

V S Babu, a two-time MLA from the Tamil Maanila Congress (TMC) representing Kolathur, has died in Chennai at the age of 75 after a prolonged illness. Babu had previously defeated current Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M K Stalin in the 2006 assembly elections from the Kolathur constituency. He was first elected to the Tamil Nadu assembly in 2006 on a DMK ticket.
